Hey! I'm Roba Copilot — ready to help you build something innovative. Here's what we can do:

🤖 Custom Robot Design
"Design a modular octopus‑inspired robot with flexible suction‑cup limbs for underwater exploration."
"Create a tiny swarm of insect‑size robots that can attach to surfaces and collectively map environments."
"Build a humanoid robot with interchangeable armor plates for rapid adaptation to different tasks."

⚙️ Physics & Simulation
"Simulate a soft‑body robot that deforms to squeeze through tight passages using realistic material properties."
"Model a robot with magnetic wheels that can climb metallic walls and adjust traction dynamically."
"Explore cooperative dynamics by simulating multiple robots balancing a shared payload on a floating platform."

🛠️ Build & Experiment

"Construct a bipedal robot that learns to walk on uneven terrain using reinforcement learning in simulation."
"Test a robotic arm that can assemble simple structures from modular building blocks in real time."

⌨️ Code & Controls
"Program expressive facial gestures for a social robot using blended joint actuation."
"Implement a PID‑controlled drone stabilizer that reacts to wind gusts in the simulation."
"Create a keyboard‑driven teleoperation interface to pilot a multi‑legged robot through obstacle courses."
